# GET /api/v1/orgs/{org}/public_members/{username}

Check if a user is a public member of an organization. Returns 204 if public member, 404 otherwise.

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** none · **ID:** `ep-073`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| org | path | string | True |
| username | path | string | True |

## Response

**204** — empty

- **404** — User is not a public member
